title: Enterprise Manufacturing Visual Quality Inspection: <15ms Edge PatchCore/YOLO + Gray-Zone VLM Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Streaming Every Line Camera Frame to Cloud VLM (GPT-4o/Claude)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 850ms latency misses 50ms PLC pneumatic reject gate by 17x ($690K/mo)

tiers.name: Tier 2: Legacy Rule-Based Pixel Threshold AOI (Halcon/Cognex Rules Only)
tiers.verdict: 28.5% over-kill false rejects from harmless glare/water drops require 45 manual re-inspectors

tiers.name: Tier 3: Closed-Set Supervised YOLO Only (No Unsupervised Anomaly or VLM Escalation)
tiers.verdict: Misses 6.4% of novel zero-day defects not present in supervised training labels

tiers.name: Tier 4: 8.5ms Edge YOLOv11+PatchCore (Jetson Orin) + 4.5% Gray-Zone 7B VLM Buffer
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 8.5ms inline trigger, 0.06% escape, 0.8% over-kill & -89.6% TCO ($72K/mo)
